state_owner.statement: Each state transition has one explicit state owner supplied by the application manifest.

mutation_authority.statement: A state mutation is accepted only for a declared action authority.

valid_predecessor_roles.statement: Only declared predecessor object roles may enter the transition.

authorized_successor_templates.statement: Successor objects must use a declared output template.

value_conservation.statement: Application value outputs cannot exceed value inputs after declared transfers.

fee_separation.statement: Transaction fees are modeled separately from application-owned value.

nonce_epoch_replay.statement: A consumed nonce cannot authorize the same state transition again.

resource_ceilings.statement: Declared resource ceilings are checked before plan construction.

exit_recovery.statement: Recovery requires the declared recovery authority and remains an operator-mediated local plan.

availability_assumptions.statement: Unavailable external providers cannot be represented as successful execution.

external_proof_device_assumptions.statement: Missing external proof or device evidence requires human review.

composition_assumptions.statement: Composed dependencies are identified by exact digest rather than name alone.

forbidden_transitions.statement: A transition must not bypass the declared exit and recovery path.
